name: GitHub CLI
description: Installs the GitHub CLI (gh) with dnf where available, falling back to the release tarball. The upstream devcontainers/features/github-cli is apt-only, so it cannot run on an RPM base.

version.description: Version to install when using the release tarball. Ignored when dnf is used -- there you get whatever the distro packages.

useRelease.description: Force the pinned release tarball even when dnf is available. Use when you need an exact version rather than the distro's.

installManPages.description: Install gh's man pages (229 of them, ~950 KB). Release-tarball path only; dnf decides for itself. 'gh --help' works either way.
